observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a friendly, encouraging tone to make contemporary dance accessible to beginners. She breaks down complex movements into smaller, manageable parts and provides clear, descriptive imagery to guide the student.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the routine and explains who it is for.
The teacher breaks down the first section of the routine.
The teacher practices the first section with music.
The teacher breaks down the second section of the routine.
The teacher practices the second section with music.
The teacher breaks down the third section of the routine.

metaphors: creating a frame with your hands
kiss together like a little mermaid
common_mistakes: not dropping the head when clasping hands
not lifting the chin with the hands

steps_taught.name: brush
steps_taught.description: brush right arm up as if painting a wall

steps_taught.name: plie frame
steps_taught.description: bend knees and create a frame with hands

steps_taught.name: thread
steps_taught.description: right arm reaches through the middle and high

steps_taught.name: sway
steps_taught.description: sway to the right and left

steps_taught.name: lift chin
steps_taught.description: lift up and lift your chin

steps_taught.name: pot de bourree
steps_taught.description: step right foot, left foot crosses behind, step right foot

what_works: The teacher breaks down the routine into small, manageable sections.
The teacher uses clear, descriptive imagery to explain the movements.
what_hinders: The teacher does not always mirror the movements, which can be confusing for beginners.
